name: SANRO Flame Glass 02
short: Dark mahogany door with a flame-shaped multicolor abstract art-glass insert.
description: A rich mahogany leaf framed by matching casing holds a tapered vertical art-glass panel swirling with red, orange, yellow, green, and blue. Horizontal recessed grooves step down each side of the glass for a contemporary rhythm.
design: Central flame-shaped stained-glass insert flanked by stacked horizontal groove panels on both sides.

name: SANRO Zen Slat 07
short: Espresso door with a full-height stack of thirteen horizontal recessed slats.
description: Deep espresso wood wraps a large recessed field filled with thirteen narrow horizontal slats. The solid outer stile keeps a calm, Zen-leaning modern profile with a small vertical pull.
design: Thirteen narrow horizontal wooden slats stacked inside one large recessed rectangular panel.

name: SANRO Zen Blossom 11
short: Mahogany door with vertical frosted glass showing a blossom-branch motif.
description: Deep reddish mahogany surrounds a narrow frosted glass pane etched with dark branches and orange-gold blossoms. Concentric recessed moldings and stacked square accents give the leaf a refined geometric frame.
design: Central vertical frosted glass with branch art, concentric rectangular moldings, and offset square accents.

name: SANRO Floral Crescent 15
short: Mahogany door with a tall crescent art-glass panel and sunburst floral motif.
description: Dark mahogany curves around a right-hand crescent of amber-frosted glass featuring a central flower with radiating gold lines. Three contoured recessed panels on the left follow the glass arc.
design: Vertical crescent art-glass on the right with three stacked contoured wood panels on the left.

name: SANRO Classic Panel Six 19
short: Warm honey-oak six-panel door with twin uprights over four horizontals.
description: Medium honey oak shows clear grain across a traditional six-panel leaf. Two tall vertical recessed panels sit above four stacked horizontal panels, finished with a slim brushed chrome lever.
design: Two vertical upper panels over four stacked horizontal recessed panels.

name: SANRO Tulip Wave 23
short: Warm wood door with oval panels and four curved tulip art-glass inserts.
description: Warm teak-toned wood pairs a large upper-left oval and lower-right oval with four frosted glass cutouts in an S-curve. Each pane shows pink, red, and yellow tulips with green leaves.
design: Asymmetric oval wood panels flanking four floral glass inserts in a vertical wave path.

name: SANRO Classic Oval 27
short: Mahogany raised-panel door with a scalloped oval top and solid base panel.
description: Warm mid-tone mahogany highlights deep tiered moldings around a tall arched top field with a central oval motif. A smaller rectangular raised panel anchors the bottom under a satin nickel knob.
design: Scalloped arched top panel with central oval above one rectangular raised bottom panel.

name: SANRO Classic Six 31
short: Honey-oak six-panel door with elongated uppers and square base panels.
description: Warm honey oak carries a symmetrical 2×3 recessed layout with bevelled moulding. Tall upper pairs step down to mid panels and two small squares at the base, finished with a long brass pull.
design: Symmetrical six-panel layout with elongated upper panels and square bottom panels.

name: SANRO Linear Horizon 35
short: Deep mahogany door with six equal horizontal recessed panels stacked full-height.
description: Rich reddish mahogany is cut into six equal horizontal fields by clean parallel grooves. A slim black vertical pull keeps the look architectural and understated.
design: Vertical stack of six equal-width horizontal rectangular panels separated by deep grooves.

name: SANRO Offset Inlay 39
short: Warm oak door with staggered dark mahogany horizontal accent blocks.
description: Medium warm oak fills a large recessed field of horizontal planks. Four darker reddish panels sit offset in a brick-like rhythm, with a recessed silver vertical handle on the left.
design: Central recessed horizontal stack with four staggered dark wood accent rectangles.

name: SANRO Lattice Grid 43
short: Golden oak door with a central ladder of six panels inside a framed grid.
description: Warm golden oak shows a vertical column of six equal recessed panels. Long vertical and horizontal grooves form an outer lattice border around the central stack, paired with a chrome lever on a long backplate.
design: Central six-panel ladder framed by outer vertical and horizontal recessed grid lines.

name: SANRO Tulip Column 48
short: Mahogany door with a narrow tulip art-glass column over four base panels.
description: Dark cherry-mahogany balances a tall frosted glass strip of pink tulips and green vines in the upper center. Outer vertical panels flank the glass while four horizontal recessed panels ground the lower half.
design: Central vertical floral glass flanked by stacked vertical panels above four horizontal base panels.

name: SANRO Tulip Vista 52
short: Dark mahogany door with a tall pink-tulip glass pane and ladder base.
description: Deep mahogany frames a colorful vertical glass insert of three pink tulips with swirling vines across the upper two-thirds. Slim vertical side panels and four evenly spaced horizontal base panels complete the leaf, with an antique brass pull.
design: Tall central designer glass flanked by four vertical side panels and four horizontal base panels.

name: SANRO Floral Arc 56
short: Light oak door with staggered ovals and a sweeping tulip glass arc.
description: Light-to-medium oak pairs a top-left oval and bottom-right oval with four frosted glass inserts in a vertical arc. Pink, purple, and red tulip motifs brighten each pane against a soft wood field.
design: Two staggered oval wood panels with four curved decorative floral glass inserts between them.

name: SANRO Square Maze 60
short: Mahogany door with concentric L-grooves and twin columns of square accents.
description: Dark mahogany shows nested rectangular channels with L-shaped recesses along the top and left. Three small squares stack on the upper right and three more on the lower left for an asymmetric modern grid.
design: Concentric rectangular grooves with vertical columns of three square accents opposite each other.

name: SANRO Dual Tone Slat 64
short: Honey teak door with staggered mahogany inlays in a dark outer frame.
description: Warm teak fills a central recessed field of horizontal segments. Four dark reddish blocks stagger down the stack for contrast, set in a thick espresso frame with a long brushed nickel pull.
design: Horizontal slat field with four staggered dark wood rectangles inside a contrasting dark frame.

name: SANRO Asymmetric Seven 68
short: Mahogany multi-panel door with five small rails, a tall stile, and a base square.
description: Deep reddish mahogany uses traditional recessed bevels in an asymmetric layout. Five small horizontal panels stack on the left beside one tall vertical panel, resting on a large near-square base field.
design: Five stacked left horizontals, one tall right vertical, and one large bottom square panel.

name: SANRO Rose Crescent 72
short: Mahogany door with a right-hand rose crescent glass and curved side panels.
description: Deep mahogany cradles an elongated crescent of amber-frosted glass with a detailed rose, leaves, and radiant curves. Three left-side recessed panels bend to match the glass contour under a round brushed metal knob.
design: Right crescent rose art-glass balanced by three curved recessed wooden panels on the left.

name: SANRO Amber Crescent 76
short: Mahogany door with left crescent glass in yellow-amber vine art.
description: Warm mahogany places a leaf-shaped frosted glass pane on the left with yellow, orange, and black vine florals. Three contoured wood panels on the right echo the glass curve for an organic asymmetric face.
design: Left vertical crescent decorative glass with three matching curved recessed panels on the right.

name: SANRO Heritage Five 80
short: Warm mahogany five-panel door with twin uprights over three horizontals.
description: Rich warm mahogany shows a classic five-panel leaf: two tall vertical recesses above three stacked horizontal panels. Slim silver hardware and white casing keep the look traditional and residential.
design: Two vertical upper panels above three stacked horizontal recessed panels.

name: SANRO Still Life Glass 84
short: Mahogany door with a fruit-and-flower stained-glass upper and solid base panel.
description: Deep mahogany divides into a large rectangular art-glass head and a single recessed wood base. The glass shows a woven basket of fruit and bright flowers inside a blue-and-white geometric border.
design: Full-width decorative glass upper panel over one classic recessed rectangular lower panel.

name: SANRO Mosaic Inlay 89
short: Teak door with offset mahogany mosaic blocks and a matching wood pull.
description: Warm medium teak holds a large recessed field of horizontal planks punctuated by four darker reddish inserts. A vertical light-wood handle continues the clean contemporary material story.
design: Horizontal plank field with four offset dark rectangular inlays and a flush wood pull.

name: SANRO Hourglass Bloom 93
short: Honey oak door with hourglass frosted glass and purple floral branch art.
description: Warm oak shapes an hourglass recess around a tall tapered frosted pane of purple flowers on a dark branch. Horizontal slats taper toward the center above and below the glass for a geometric flare.
design: Central hourglass art-glass insert flanked by tapering horizontal decorative slats.

name: SANRO Classic Vista 97
short: Honey-oak five-panel door with beveled recesses and pre-drilled lock prep.
description: Uniform warm honey oak presents two vertical upper panels over three stacked horizontals. Beveled recessed edges add depth; handle holes are prepared on the left without installed hardware.
design: Two vertical panels above three stacked horizontal beveled recessed panels.

name: SANRO Classic Ladder 101
short: Warm mahogany door with twin vertical tops over four ladder horizontals.
description: Warm brown mahogany grain runs across a six-panel classic leaf. Two long vertical recesses sit above four shorter horizontal panels, finished with a slim satin-gold vertical plate.
design: Two vertical top panels over four stacked horizontal rectangular bottom panels.

name: SANRO Grid Horizon 105
short: Honey oak door with five central panels inside a recessed geometric border.
description: Medium honey oak centers five equal rectangular recesses in a vertical column. Thin outer grooves form a clean grid frame, paired with a long ornate chrome handle on the right.
design: Vertical column of five rectangular panels centered within a geometric recessed grid frame.

name: SANRO Classic Six Panel 109
short: Warm teak six-panel door with traditional moulding and a tall brass pull.
description: Orange-brown warm teak shows a traditional six-panel arrangement with bevelled moulding. Square base panels support mid and upper rectangular pairs under a long vertical brass handle.
design: Symmetrical six-panel layout with two base squares and four rectangular panels above.

name: SANRO Floral Hourglass 113
short: Warm oak hourglass door with a purple vine art-glass center pane.
description: Light warm oak carves an hourglass field around frosted glass printed with a vertical vine of green leaves and purple blooms. Tiered horizontal grooves taper toward the glass at top and bottom.
design: Hourglass-shaped frame with central floral glass and tiered horizontal grooves above and below.

name: SANRO Peony Crescent 117
short: Dark mahogany door with a peony sunburst crescent glass and left stack panels.
description: Deep mahogany contrasts three stacked rectangular recesses on the left with a sweeping arched glass field on the right. Amber sunburst rays and a large peony-style flower fill the frosted insert.
design: Three left recessed panels beside a large crescent floral glass with sunburst rays.

name: SANRO Aurora Wave 121
short: Mahogany door with a wave-shaped multicolor glass and side ladder panels.
description: Rich mahogany frames a vertical wave of abstract stained glass in red, yellow, orange, blue, and green. Six horizontal recesses on the left and five on the right step beside the glass under a slim brass pull.
design: Central wave-shaped art-glass insert with horizontal ladder panels on both sides.

name: SANRO Classic Multi-Panel 125
short: Deep mahogany asymmetric seven-panel door with bevelled traditional moulding.
description: Polished mahogany arranges five small horizontal panels beside one tall vertical, over a large bottom square. Bevelled recesses and a slim chrome plate suit formal rooms with rich wood character.
design: Asymmetric seven-panel layout: five left horizontals, one tall vertical, one large base square.

name: SANRO Cherry Blossom Glass 130
short: Dark cherry door with blossom-branch frosted glass and square accent carvings.
description: Dark reddish mahogany centers a narrow frosted pane of stylized branches with orange-gold blossoms. Concentric rectangular grooves and columns of small square accents create a layered geometric border.
design: Narrow vertical floral-branch glass framed by concentric panels and stacked square accents.

name: SANRO Amber Vine 134
short: Dark walnut-tone door with left crescent glass in amber floral vine art.
description: Dark brown wood sets a tall left crescent of frosted glass painted with amber, gold, and black florals. Three arched recessed panels on the right follow the glass edge under a round satin-nickel knob.
design: Left crescent decorative glass with three arched recessed wood panels on the right.

name: SANRO Geometric Maze 138
short: Mahogany door with nested vertical rectangles and six corner square motifs.
description: Deep mahogany traces two large concentric vertical rectangles around a central field. Three small squares stack at the top right and three at the bottom left for a crisp modern maze pattern.
design: Nested vertical rectangular panels with three decorative squares on upper right and lower left.

name: SANRO Geometric Inlay 142
short: Light oak door with staggered mahogany inlays inside a thick dark frame.
description: Light-to-medium oak fills a recessed horizontal-slat field. Four dark reddish rectangles stagger down the right of the panel for bold contrast, framed in near-black casing with a long cylindrical nickel pull.
design: Central horizontal-slat panel with four staggered dark wood accents in a dark outer frame.

name: SANRO Frame Grid 146
short: Warm teak door with five central panels bordered by a full recessed frame grid.
description: Medium warm teak stacks five square-to-rectangular recesses down the center. Side verticals plus top and bottom horizontals complete a border grid, finished with an elongated chrome handle.
design: Central five-panel stack framed by flanking verticals and top/bottom horizontal recesses.

name: SANRO Classic Penta 150
short: Honey-oak five-panel door with raised moulding and open lock prep holes.
description: Uniform honey oak presents two tall vertical panels over three shorter horizontals with decorative raised edges. Shown in a white frame without hardware, ready for a chosen lockset.
design: Two vertical rectangular panels above three stacked horizontal recessed panels.

name: SANRO Floral Tulip 154
short: Mahogany door with full-height tulip glass between verticals and a ladder base.
description: Dark mahogany centers a narrow frosted strip of three pink tulips with green vines. Four vertical side recesses flank the glass while four horizontal base panels form a solid ladder foundation; lock prep is drilled but bare.
design: Central floral glass flanked by vertical side panels and four horizontal base panels.

name: SANRO Linear Horizon 158
short: Dark chocolate door with thirteen precision horizontal slats in a flat frame.
description: Deep mahogany-chocolate wood holds a rhythmic column of thirteen recessed horizontal slats. A flat outer border and small bronze pull keep the leaf architectural and quiet.
design: Thirteen horizontal rectangular slats stacked inside a flat-surfaced outer frame.

name: SANRO Floral Wave 162
short: Light oak door with oval panels and four tulip glass panes in a wave path.
description: Honey-maple oak pairs recessed ovals at top-left and bottom-right with four frosted glass inserts in an S-curve. Bright pink and red tulip motifs keep the designer face lively while the frost adds privacy.
design: Asymmetric wave of four floral glass panes flanked by two vertical oval wood panels.

name: SANRO Heritage Manor 166
short: Warm mahogany five-panel door with raised moulding and a slim chrome pull.
description: Warm reddish mahogany shows a classic two-over-three panel leaf with raised moulding. Twin tall verticals sit above three stacked horizontals, finished with a slim silver handle in a white casing.
design: Two tall vertical upper panels above three stacked horizontal inset panels with raised edges.
